requirement: The sales forecasting system shall permit only analysts holding the forecast-editor role to create or change forecast scenarios.
The online booking system shall allow only staff with reservation-management privileges to create, modify or cancel bookings on behalf of customers.
The database server shall grant write and delete permissions on production tables solely to accounts that have been explicitly assigned a data-modification privilege.
The web browser shall prevent web pages from reading or altering the files that store saved credentials and browsing profiles, exposing them only through its controlled interfaces.
The electronic purse shall keep the stored balance unreadable and unalterable by external devices except through its defined load and debit commands.
The data warehousing system must reject a reversal of a loaded record unless it originates from the same source feed as the original load and carries identical row counts and totals.
The online booking system must accept a refund for a reservation only when it is issued from the same terminal that took the original payment and equals the amount originally charged.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall attach a keyed message authentication code, derived from a key held only by the communicating servers, to each salary file exchanged between them so that any modification is detected.
The smart-home IoT controller must verify a keyed authentication tag on every command received from a paired hub and discard any command whose tag does not match.
The simulation software shall compute a keyed checksum over the number of runs and the aggregate result values in each exported result set, so that later tampering with those figures is detectable.
The smart-home IoT controller must append a keyed authentication code covering the event count and cumulative energy reading to each telemetry bundle it uploads.

The data warehousing system shall flag any loaded dataset whose recomputed integrity code differs from the code supplied by the source, and shall start a correction procedure to restore the affected records.
The web browser shall refuse to run a downloaded extension whose signature fails verification and shall offer the user a way to restore the previously installed version.
The online booking system shall compute a fresh integrity code over the running total of reservations and revenue each time a booking is confirmed, and shall store that code with the batch record.

The air traffic control software must sign each clearance message it issues and recompute the checksum of the clearance sequence log whenever an entry is appended, so that altered entries can be detected.

The electronic purse shall, upon reversing its latest debit, restore the prior balance and regenerate the authentication code that covers the cumulative debit total, before releasing the record for collection.

The database server shall recompute the checksum covering the row count and sum of an aggregated ledger whenever a transaction is rolled back, and shall retain the rolled-back entry unchanged until archival.
The electronic purse must accept a top-up instruction only if it carries a valid authentication code computed with the key negotiated for the current session.
The database server shall execute a replication instruction from a peer node only if the accompanying message authentication code verifies against the per-connection session key.
The air traffic control software shall let a supervisor suspend a compromised workstation session remotely, and shall refuse every command from a suspended session.
The web browser shall block all further requests from an extension that the vendor has revoked as malicious, including after a restart.
The online banking application must allow the bank to freeze a customer profile showing signs of takeover and must deny every operation attempted on a frozen profile.
The smart-home IoT controller shall generate and store its encryption keys exclusively inside a tamper-resistant hardware module, so that key material is never readable outside it.
The hospital patient-record system must keep the keys that encrypt patient files in a certified hardware vault that never exports them in plaintext.
The screen capture tool shall hold the keys used to encrypt saved recordings in the operating system's hardware-backed key store, preventing other applications from reading them.

The hospital patient-record system shall abort any prescription order, and report it as failed, when a mismatch is detected in the patient identifier, drug code or dosage fields as compared with their protected checksum.
The electronic purse must decline a payment and leave the balance untouched when the verification code over the transaction number, currency and value indicates the data were modified in transit.
The online booking system must cancel a pending reservation and notify the user of the failure when the signed booking reference, date or price is found to have been manipulated.
